newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australian All Industrials seen overbought.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australian All Industrials seen overbought.

text.p: ----------------Australian All Industrials------------------
---------------Analysis by Daniel Fock - April 29-----------
*Index retreats from previous high
*Indicators overbought
*Retracement possible
*All Industrials Index closed at 3,874.3 on Monday
The Australian All Industrials
Index (Monday close; 3,874.3) continued higher in the last week,
but was unable to break its previous high at 3,913.
The index is over-extended and with leading indicators extremely overbought, traders are likely to prepare for a possible retracement by tightening trailing stops on long positions.
Short term technicals are bullish and overbought. Moving averages are bullish. The week is begining on a weak note.
Leading indicators are higher and very overbought, but turning lower.
Cautious bulls will focus on lower Fibonacci retracement levels of 3,808, 3,779, 3,750.
These are quite far away, so traders will most likely take profits earlier, possibily on a break of 3,860 or 3,830.
In the medium term, the index is near last week's high but begining the week slightly lower.
Like the short term, traders will remain bullish, and raise trailing stops.
Medium term technicals are bullish. The averages are bullish, but the leading indicators are mixed.
The ROC and RSI, while slightly higher than last week, look to be turning lower.
Stochastics continue higher.
Due to the rapid rise, the index has not stopped, consolidated or retraced in the last 3 weeks.
Traders will be cautious, and focus on the same levels as the short term.
In the longer term, the index has made an outside range month, so far, and is above last month's high.
The index is still bullish, but must finish at the higher end of the range to keep the longer term bulls contented.
Longer term technicals are bullish and overbought. So traders will generally remain cautious.
The index is just of the highs of last week, starting the week slightly weaker, and overbought.
With the end of the month on Wednesday, traders will be keen to bank book profits on the current three week rise.
While still in all bull channels, the index is due for a correction or consolidation. The month end could be the catalyst.
Due to the steep rise retracements targets far away, and traders will most possibly move trailing stops quite close to current levels.
The 3,860 and 3,830 levels are key levels if trailing stops have not already been triggered.
(Daniel Fock is a member of the Australian Technical Analysis Association. Views are his own, not those of Reuters.)
